jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
IES Österåker opened in August 2024. We are a F-9 school, 2 parallel classes with up to 610 students. We are committed to our ethos which is a school with a calm and safe learning environment, bilingual teaching and high academic expectations.

IESÖ follows the Swedish national curriculum while embracing bilingualism and the command of the English language . After grade 3 up to 50% of the lessons are taught in English. 

The school is located in central Åkersberga, about 30 minutes from Stockholm and a 5 minute walk from Roslagsbanan. Our campus combines newly built and renovated facilities and is close to sports facilities, nature, and the Stockholm archipelago.

We are looking for a positive, creative, and service-minded person who will play an important role in creating a welcoming and engaging atmosphere at our school. You will have an integral role in key events and celebrations both from an organisational perspective as well as the practical. Many things that make IES Österåker special is that which is above and beyond the ordinary. 

It is important that you are comfortable with the creative and innovative side of things and that you interact well with children of all ages. You will assist students, parents, staff, and visitors, answer questions, manage day-to-day reception tasks, and help create a positive first impression of the school.

This includes welcoming and assisting visitors, ensuring no one enters the school without authorisation and vetting , helping maintain a safe and secure school environment, handling general office administration such as deliveries, managing incoming and outgoing post and supporting the practical organisation of the school among other things.We are looking for someone who:

- Has excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Is confident, welcoming, and professional when interacting with students, parents, staff, and visitors.
- Enjoys working in a busy school environment where no two days are exactly the same.
- Is highly organised and able to coordinate several tasks and events at the same time.
- Is creative and enjoys coming up with ideas for events, activities, and communication.
- Has an interest in social media, photography, content creation, or digital communication.
- Is flexible, solution-oriented, and happy to help wherever needed.
- Has excellent English and Swedish communication skills, both written and spoken.
- Swedish drivers licence is a plus What we offer

- A varied and creative role at a growing international school.
- A role where your ideas and initiative can make a real difference.
- A dynamic working environment where you will meet students, staff, parents, and visitors every day.
- Supportive and dedicated colleagues.
- The opportunity to help build and develop a growing school.
- A culture focused on learning, respect, community, and academic success.

The position is 100%

We apply a 6-month probationary period. 

Interviews will be conducted continuously during the application period, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. 

To apply, you need a valid extract from the criminal records register for work in schools.

Would you like to work with a product loved by millions and millions of kids all across the world? With over 60 million monthly active users engaging with our play ecosystem, we are looking for a Senior Copywriter to join our Creative Hub. Working alongside highly talented animators, designers, and creative leads, you will play a defining role in telling great stories that inform, entertain, and bring Toca Boca’s products to life with relatable narratives that truly connect with kids and families globally.

You will be the guardian of our global Tone of Voice. You will balance visionary, high-level campaign ideation with hands-on creative execution, ensuring that Toca Boca sounds exactly like Toca Boca wherever we show up.

What you’ll be doing

Partner with Art Directors and Creative Leads to drive creative concepts and storytelling from the first brief all the way to final launch.

Create narrative-led marketing content (trailers, promo videos, full 360° campaigns) with relatable copy that truly connects with our core tween audience.

Balance high-level visionary work with hands-on daily production (VO scripts, performance ads, social captions, and in-app copy).

Leverage knowledge of platform specs (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram) to adapt copy natively while ensuring English source text is flawlessly structured for localization.

Own, update, and protect the Toca Boca Tone of Voice, ensuring everything we publish globally sounds exactly like us.

Partner with Product and Marketing to shape our stories, review creative output, and support the wider team in writing their own copy.

Identify opportunities to use emerging tools and technology to improve creative workflows.

Is This You?

You have 5+ years of experience working as a Copywriter, preferably with experience stepping into Creative Lead or conceptual roles. You thrive on balancing high-level visionary campaign strategy with hands-on, daily operational execution.

You hold a Bachelor's degree or similar in Copywriting, Communications, English, Creative Writing, or a related field, or you have equivalent professional experience.

You are a native English speaker with flawless grammar, sharp editing skills, and structurally precise writing.

You have experience developing, maintaining, and guarding a brand's Tone of Voice across multiple touchpoints.

You have a deep understanding of current social media trends, community engagement, and digital-first campaign storytelling. Prior experience in digital gaming, entertainment, or youth-focused tech is a major plus!

What we’ll be looking for in your portfolio

360° campaigns where you drove both the high-level concept and the final narrative arc.

Emotionally resonant work targeting tweens that feels authentic.

Examples proving you can define, adapt, and guard a distinct brand voice across digital, social, and physical touchpoints.

A strong mix of visionary thinking and sharp daily execution (social media content).

Flawless native English writing with the precision required for a sensitive audience.

Impactful copy built on universal truths rather than local slang, proving it can be translated globally without losing its core DNA. (Bonus)

This is us!

Toca Boca together with Sago Mini, Piknik and Lylli, make up Digital Games within Spin Master. We create games, digital toys, and everyday products that are filled with fun that kids from any corner of the world can instantly relate to. We celebrate the diversity and quirkiness of their world and give them the freedom to play in ways that only they can.

The Spin Master Mission and Vision is to make life more fun by pushing the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun!

Good to know!

This position is full time and based in our Stockholm office with a hybrid working model. We apply a 6-month probationary period. As we’re an international company, with over 20 nationalities working here, and millions of users all over the world, you must be fluent in English.

Toca Boca develops digital games that capture the power of play and that are filled with fun and silliness that kids around the world can instantly relate to. Since our first product launch in 2011, we have released 46 apps that have been downloaded more than 444 million times the world over, making us the No. 1 mobile-first kids brand in the App Store. Our products focus on sparking kids’ creativity and imagination, creating opportunities for open-ended play.

With offices in Stockholm and San Francisco, Toca Boca is owned by Spin Master Corp., a global children’s entertainment company that creates, designs and manufactures a diversified portfolio of innovative toys, games, products and entertainment properties.

Join Our Team as a QA Manager
We are looking for a full time Quality Assurance Manager to join and strengthen the GMP Operations team at Anocca.
The GMP operations team currently consist of a production team, a QC team, QA managers including QP, facility manager, validation and project managers, for a total of approximately 30 colleagues.
You will be involved in the quality assurance of all operative activities, including document approval, deviation investigations, material release, training of employees, validation of equipment, maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS) and validation of methods for release of ATMP products, to be used in clinical trials. Also, document administration will be an important part of this role.
Previous experience in Quality Assurance (QA) within a GMP environment is required for this role'
Experience in regulatory guidelines for ATMP (EudraLex Vol.4), aseptic work (EudraLex Annex 1) or in microbiology would be a significant asset.
You must be capable of working as part of a team and as the company and team is very international and the business language is English, excellent English communication skills both in speech and in writing is required.
The role is suited to motivated persons with a drive to learn and grow in a complex and varied environment.
What we are looking for:
• BSc or MSc in life science subject (biology, pharmacy, chemistry or similar)
• Previous experience in QA role 
• Meticulous documentation administration skills
• Experienced in deviation investigations, CC and CAPAs
• Fluent written and spoken English

We offer:
An international workplace with plenty of variety in the job, interaction with all other Anocca employees and the opportunity to work at the exciting intersection of biotechnology and medicine.
Compensation:
• Monthly salary
• Tier 1 occupational pension plan
• Wellness grant
• Flexible work hours

How to Apply:
If this QA position resonates with you, we would love to hear from you. Submit your application, including your CV and a cover letter, through our careers portal. Join us in making a difference, apply now!
We ensure unbiased recruitment by hiding your personal information such as name, email, etc. and photos from the recruiter during the screening process.

About VAST
VAST is a geomorphic landform design consultancy. We design mine closure landforms that behave like natural landscapes, and we work directly with mining clients in Sweden, Australia and Canada.
The role
The main role is landform design, including conceptual and detailed design for mine closure and waste rock management. Other responsibilities include reference site investigations, landform monitoring (including sediment and hydrology monitoring), research and innovation, and technical reporting and writing. We will train the successful candidate in landform design. Prior design experience is welcome but not required.
Requirements
Education (required): A relevant degree of at least two years’ post-secondary study in one of: landscape architecture, geomorphology, geography, geology, mining or mine closure engineering, environmental or civil engineering, forestry, or a related discipline.
Essential experience: at least 2 years of relevant experience in GIS, fluvial or sediment monitoring, or applied research.
Essential skills:
Advanced GIS skills, for example ArcGIS, QGIS or Python.
Knowledge of fluvial geomorphology, sediment transport and erosion rates, and how to monitor them.
Clear technical writing in English.

Desirable: background in landform or geomorphic design, mine closure or waste rock; field survey and remote sensing skills (total station, GNSS, drone photogrammetry, LiDAR).
No prior landscape architecture experience is required.
Language: English, required.
Please include CV with your application.

jobs.employer_name: ISMG (International Sales and Marketing Group) AB
jobs.description:
Sv:
Nu söker vi nya medarbetare till vår verksamhet i Uppsala. Tjänsten innebär att du byter batterier på elskotrar runt om i Uppsala samt utför snabba kvalitetskontroller och ibland omplacering av elskotrarna. Du utgår från vårt lager på Verkstadsgatan. Tjänsten är en behovsanställning med tim- och ackordbaserad lön. Det är varierande arbetstider och du ska kunna jobba kvällar, nätter och helger. Svenska eller engelska är ett krav, och vi vill också att du innehar B-körkort.
Intervjuer och anställning sker löpande.

English:
We are now looking for new co-workers for our operations in Uppsala. As an e-Scooter Field Operative you will be transporting batteries with a van to the e-scooters around Uppsala in order to change them on site. You will also perform quick quality checks on the vehicles to ensure the vehicles are in good condition and follow all local guidelines set by the authorities. You might also perform relocation of the e-scooters from time to time. The employment is a zero hour contract with hourly and performance based salary. The work times are varied and you need to be able to work evenings, nights and weekends. Speaking Swedish or English is required, you also need to have a class B drivers license.
Interviews and hiring takes place on an ongoing basis.

Svenska
Vi söker personer som står bakom våra värderingar och som inte är rädda för att anta utmaningar, tänka nytt, experimentera och arbeta i ett högt tempo. Vi letar alltid efter sätt att förbättra både våra lösningar och oss själva. Känner du igen dig i detta och har de kompetenser vi söker, vill vi gärna komma i kontakt med dig. Bli en del av vår framtid på SMS group i Boden, Sverige.
English
We are looking for people who embrace our values, who are not afraid to take on challenges, innovate, experiment and go at a fast pace. We are always looking for ways to improve our solutions and ourselves. If this applies to you and you have the following skills, we would like to talk to you. Become a part of our future at SMS group in Boden, Sweden
Om rollen / About the role
Svenska
Har du ett starkt engagemang för att skapa en arbetsplats som är hälsosam, säker, hållbar och håller hög kvalitet? Då kan du vara precis den person vi söker. Som QHSE-chef (kvalitet, hälsa, säkerhet och miljö) arbetar du brett inom QHSE-området för att säkerställa en säker, hållbar och högkvalitativ verksamhet. Du samordnar QHSE-arbetet på ett systematiskt sätt och driver initiativ för ständiga förbättringar. Arbetet är varierande och innebär mycket samarbete och nära samverkan i hela organisationen. Du kommer till exempel att stötta organisationens chefer och rapportera till ledningen.
Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat att:
Implementera, upprätthålla och vidareutveckla QHSE-processer och ledningssystem.
Främja en säkerhetskultur i organisationen och säkerställa efterlevnad av tillämpliga lagar och föreskrifter inom kvalitet, arbetsmiljö, säkerhet och miljö.
Utbilda medarbetare i QHSE-rutiner och främja medvetenheten om QHSE i organisationen.
Ta fram och genomföra introduktionsutbildningar inom QHSE för nyanställda.
Utreda incidenter och olyckor samt vidta lämpliga korrigerande och förebyggande åtgärder för att förhindra att de inträffar igen.
Vara en naturlig kontaktperson gentemot myndigheter och andra intressenter.

English
Do you have a passion for ensuring that a workplace is healthy, safe, sustainable, and of high quality? Then you might be exactly who we are looking for. As the QHSE (Quality, Health, Safety, and Environment) Manager, you will work comprehensively within the QHSE area to ensure a safe, sustainable, and high-quality operation. You will systematically coordinate the QHSE efforts and drive continuous improvement initiatives. The work is varied and involves a great deal of collaboration and close cooperation throughout the entire organization. For example, you will support the organization's managers and report to the management.
Work tasks include, but are not limited to:
Implement, maintain, and develop QHSE processes and management systems
Promote a culture of safety within the organization and ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations concerning quality, occupational health, safety, and the environment
Train employees in QHSE procedures and promote a culture of QHSE awareness within the organization
Develop and deliver QHSE induction training for new employees
Investigate incidents and accidents, and take appropriate corrective and preventative actions to prevent reoccurrence
Serve as a natural point of contact with authorities and other stakeholders

Din profil / Your profile
Svenska
Du har en akademisk examen eller motsvarande utbildning och erfarenhet inom ett relevant område, samt minst fem års yrkeserfarenhet av QHSE-arbete och ledningssystem baserade på standarderna ISO 9001, ISO 14001 och ISO 45001.
Du är ansvarstagande och kan arbeta självständigt. Du har också god analytisk förmåga och är skicklig på problemlösning. Dessutom har du lätt för att bygga relationer och skapa nya kontakter, eftersom rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med alla avdelningar i organisationen. Du behärskar engelska väl, både i tal och skrift.
English
You either hold an academic degree or equivelant education/experience in a relevant field combined with at least five years of professional experience working with QHSE and management systems based on ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001 standards. You are responsible and capable of working independently, while also possessing strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Additionally, you have a high ability at building relationships and to easily establish new connections, as the role involves close collaboration with all departments within the organization. Proficiency in English, both spoken and written, is required.
Om SMS group/Abour SMS group
Svenska
Med 150 års erfarenhet och digital kompetens levererar vi kontinuerligt innovativa produkter och processer till industrin. Vårt mål är att bana väg för en koldioxidneutral och hållbar metallindustri.
SMS group är en ledande partner för krävande industriprojekt och stöttar kunderna under hela anläggningarnas livscykel. Hos oss finns internationella karriärmöjligheter. Som globalt företag har vi fler än 14 400 medarbetare på över 100 orter. 
English
We use our 150 years of experience and digital expertise to continuously deliver innovative products and processes to the industry. Our goal is to pave the way for a carbon‑neutral and sustainable metals industry. SMS is a leading partner for challenging industrial projects and supports customers throughout the lifecycle of their plants. With us you will find international career opportunities. As a global company we employ more than 14,400 people at over 100 locations. 
Är detta för dig? / Is this for you?
Svenska
Vill du vara med och forma framtiden tillsammans med oss? Skicka gärna in din ansökan med CV och personligt brev. Har du frågor är du varmt välkommen att kontakta oss.
Urvalet sker löpande under ansökningsperioden. Tjänsten kan därför komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, den 31 december 2026.
English
Are you keen on shaping the future with us? If so, feel free to send us your application of a CV and personal letter. Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us. Please note that the selection process is ongoing during the application period, and that the postion maby be filled before the application deadline of 31 dec, 2026.

jobs.occupation: Vi söker elektriker / We are looking for electricians
jobs.description:
Om SMS group / About SMS group 
Svenska
SMS group är världsledande när det gäller framtidsinriktade teknologier och enastående service för metallindustrin. År 2024 genererade vårt team på över 13 500 anställda världen över en omsättning på mer än 4 miljarder euro. Vi tillämpar våra 150 års erfarenhet och vår digitala expertis för att kontinuerligt tillhandahålla branschen innovativa produkter och processer som sträcker sig bortom vår kärnverksamhet. Vi är den rätta partnern för utmanande projekt och stödjer våra kunder genom hela livscykeln för deras anläggningar och utrustning. Att bana vägen för en koldioxidneutral och hållbar metallindustri är vårt uttalade mål.
English
SMS group is a global leader in pioneering technologies and outstanding services for the metals industry. In 2024, our team of more than 13,500 employees worldwide generated sales of over €4 billion. We draw on 150 years of experience and our digital expertise to continuously provide the industry with innovative products and processes that extend beyond our core business. We are the right partner for challenging projects, supporting our customers throughout the entire lifecycle of their plants and equipment. Our clear goal is to pave the way for a carbon-neutral and sustainable metals industry.
Om Rollen / About the role
Svenska:
Som elektriker hos oss kommer du att arbeta med både låg- och högspänningsarbeten, främst riktade mot vår maskinpark som inkluderar utrustning såsom slip- och fräsmaskiner. Du kommer att vara ansvarig för underhåll och felsökning av elektriska system och instrument för att säkerställa optimal drift och säkerhet. Arbetet kräver att du har en gedigen förståelse för elektriska kretsar och komponenter samt en förmåga att arbeta med komplexa maskiner.
English:
As an electrician with us you will work with both low- and high-voltage tasks, primarily focused on our machinery fleet which includes equipment such as grinding and milling machines. You will be responsible for maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical systems and instruments to ensure optimal operation and safety. The role requires a solid understanding of electrical circuits and components as well as the ability to work with complex machines.
Din profil / Your profile
Svenska
Vi söker dig som har god erfarenhet av rollen som elektriker och är bekväm med att arbeta med både maskiner så som Roll Grinding och CNC maskiner samt ställverk inom tung industri.
Du arbetar systematiskt vid felsökning, oavsett om det handlar om automationssystem eller maskiner och använder dig av olika verktyg så som ritningar och elscheman för att sätta dig in i systemet/maskinens funktion och konstruktion.
Du har gymnasieexamen inom el och automation, alternativt likvärdig yrkesutbildning eller erfarenhet. Det är viktigt att du har den certifiering som krävs för att kunna utföra el arbetet. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att jobba i underhållssystem.
Personliga egenskaper som vi värdesätter inkluderar noggrannhet, problemlösningsförmåga och en stark ansvarskänsla. Du bör också ha förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och i team, samt vara flexibel och anpassningsbar till förändringar i arbetsmiljön. Du är bekväm med att uttrycka dig på svenska och/eller engelska och förstår vikten av säkerhetsföreskrifter för att skapa en trygg och säker arbetsmiljö.
Du är en person som tar initiativ och bidrar aktivt till att förbättra och effektivisera våra arbetssätt och processer.
English
We are looking for someone with several years’ experience as an electrician and who is comfortable working with both machinery such as Roll Grinding and CNC as well as switchgears in heavy industry.
You work systematically when troubleshooting, whether you are dealing with automation systems or machines. It is natural for you to use tools such as drawings and electrical schematics to understand the system/machine function and design.
You have a secondary school diploma in electrical engineering and automation, or equivalent vocational training or experience. It is important that you have the correct cridentials to be allowed by Swedish authorities to work on electrical tasks. Experience using maintenance management systems is an advantage.
Personal qualities we value include precision, problem-solving ability and a strong sense of responsibility. You should be able to work both independently and as part of a team. It is important that you are flexible and adaptable to changes in the work environment. You are proactive and contribute actively to improving and streamlining our work methods and processes. It is a must that you are comfortable expressing yourself in Swedish and/or English and understand the importance of safety regulations to create a safe working environment for yourself and your teammates.
You are a person who takes initiative and actively contributes to improving and streamlining our ways of working and processes.
Vad vi erbjuder / What we offer
Svenska
Med SMS group hittar du internationella karriärmöjligheter. Våra värderingar ACT, SHARE, CARE, INNOVATE och SUCCEED har alltid varit en integrerad del av vårt arbete och är vad vi lovar våra kunder och anställda nu och i framtiden.
English
With SMS group you will find international career opportunities. Our values ACT, SHARE, CARE, INNOVATE and SUCCEED have always been an integral part of our work and are what we promise our customers and employees now and in the future.
Är detta för dig? / Could this be for you?
Svenska
Vill du vara med och forma framtiden tillsammans med oss? Skicka gärna in din ansökan med CV och personligt brev. Har du några frågor är du varmt välkommen att kontakta oss. Observera att urvalet sker löpande under ansökningsperioden och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag.
English
Are you keen on shaping the future with us? If so, feel free to send us your application of a CV and personal letter. Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us. Please note that the selection process is ongoing during the application period, and that the postion maby be filled before the application deadline.

jobs.employer_name: ISMG (International Sales and Marketing Group) AB
jobs.description:
Sv:
Nu söker vi nya medarbetare till vår verksamhet i Stockholm. Tjänsten innebär att du byter batterier på elskotrar runt om i Stockholm samt utför snabba kvalitetskontroller och ibland omplacering av elskotrarna. Du utgår från vårt lager på Upplandsgatan. Tjänsten är en behovsanställning med tim- och ackordbaserad lön. Det är varierande arbetstider och du ska kunna jobba kvällar, nätter och helger. Svenska eller engelska är ett krav, och du måste ha anting AM-körkort eller B-körkort.
Intervjuer och anställning sker löpande.

English:
We are now looking for new co-workers for our operations in Stockholm. As an e-Scooter Field Operative you will be transporting batteries with a van to the e-scooters around Stockholm in order to change them on site. You will also perform quick quality checks on the vehicles to ensure the vehicles are in good condition and follow all local guidelines set by the authorities. You might also perform relocation of the e-scooters from time to time. The employment is a zero hour contract with hourly pay as well as performance based. The work times are varied and you need to be able to work evenings, nights and weekends. Speaking Swedish or English is required, you also need to have a class AM or B drivers license.
Interviews and hiring takes place on an ongoing basis.

- Utbildad lärare  (grundlärarprogrammet med inriktning mot fritidshem)

Låter detta som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag och bli en del av vårt team på IES KIsta! Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till vår inspirerande och lärorika skolmiljö.

Internationella Engelska Skolan has been making a difference for students for 30 years. We are convinced that it is thanks to our strong ethos and our dedicated and present leaders that our schools create an environment where everyone works towards common goals. With us, you get the opportunity to experience the world without leaving home. The school has an international focus, and teaching is conducted in both English and Swedish. We strive to be a school where teachers can focus on teaching, students have the opportunity to learn, and where everyone enjoys coming to school.

We are now looking for flexible and committed qualified fritids teachers to join our team at IES Kista! 

 Your responsibilities may include:

- Contributing to a safe and stimulating learning environment during lessons and breaks.Planning and presenting activities for students in line with Lgr22. 
- Planning and presenting activities for students in line with Lgr22. 
- Assisting with other general school-related tasks as needed.

We offer a dynamic workday where the schedule may include both fixed hours during the week and substitute hours as required. This is a fantastic opportunity to gain experience working in a bilingual environment and to develop within the educational field!

We are looking for someone who:

- Is passionate about working with children and young people.
- Is flexible, adaptable, and works well with others.
- Has the qualification teacher in the fritidshem.
- Has good proficiency in Swedish and/or English.

Apply Today!

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? Submit your application today and become part of our team at IES Kista! We look forward to welcoming you to our inspiring and educational school environment.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.
